description: Conflicts between two to four RFC 6902 JSON Patches made against the same document — Takes one base document and 2 to 4 JSON Patch (RFC 6902) operation lists written against it and reports, per pair, whether they commute: same-path writes, ancestor/descendant overlaps, array-index shifts (an insert or remove moves the elements a later patch addressed by index), concurrent `-` appends whose final order depends on application order, `test` operations invalidated by another patch, an

document.description: The base document both patches were written against (any JSON value).

items.description: A JSON Patch operation object: {op, path, value?, from?}.

name: json-patch-conflict
